svg.title: Where a buyer's payment goes
svg.desc: Each sale pays the whole price in USDC into your payout contract, which is made from your wallet's address and has no owner. One payout transaction, sent by you at any time or by Agentify on no fixed date, pays out every sale since the last payout through the shared 0xSplits warehouse: 99.9 percent to your wallet and 0.1 percent to Agentify. A refund, if you make one, goes from your wallet to the buyer outside Agentify, and closing fulfillment of an order moves no money.
